sections.name: Opening spark
sections.reason: High opening activity and an early high; present the main motif clearly, with short bright accents.

sections.name: Losing altitude
sections.reason: The main price direction turns down while range remains elevated; let the lead descend and thicken its edges.

sections.name: The break
sections.reason: The decline steepens; use tighter percussion around the real downward contour, without inventing a news catalyst.

sections.name: Searching for a floor
sections.reason: Price stays low and reaches its session minimum; make room around a low-register motif.

sections.name: A softer recovery
sections.reason: Price recovers on lower observed volume and range; allow the melody to rise with a gentler, wider arrangement.

sections.name: The second dip
sections.reason: The recovery gives way to another decline; repeat a reduced form of the opening idea in a lower register.

sections.name: An unfinished return
sections.reason: A partial recovery reaches the close with rising observed activity late in the session; preserve the lower final register and avoid a triumphant ending.

data_note: Observed minute volume totals 28,204,051 shares, 82.92% of the provider's daily total. Dynamics use those observed volumes; no missing volume is invented.
price_convention: Open at minute 0; minute closes at boundaries 1..389; separate closing print at 390.
